subject: english
question: Select the correct option to fill blank 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**middle**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**middle**" refers to the central point or part. (बीच)
 
• In the context, it indicates that Jim woke from a dream that was in progress, not near the beginning or end.
 
• The other options: "**side**," "**between**," and "**end**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *In the middle__ of an enjoyable dream, Jim thought he heard his dog barking loudly.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Side (बगल)**: refers to a position to the left or right of an object.
 
• **Between (के बीच)**: refers to the intermediate space separating two points, objects, or states.
 
• **End (अंत)**: refers to the final or terminal point of something.
